Thanks Jordan — that later slot is fine for us. Confirming Thu 14 Jan, 13:00–14:30 GMT (90 min). Sending calendar invite now.

Quick answers to prep questions:
- Connection model: Redwood's private control plane can be configured for outbound TLS-only control edges. By default we use long-lived TLS tunnels for telemetry and control (mutual TLS). We also support a periodic polling model for fully air-gapped environments (pull-only) but that requires an isolated bundle transfer process (see attached "airgap-file-transfer-procedure.docx").
- Ports: default control plane uses 443 outbound. For high-throughput model syncs we recommend an allowed egress to our signed S3 endpoint (HTTPS) or an approved pull server; details in checklist.
- HSM/KMS: we support customer-managed KMS (via standard KMIP/HSM integrations) and can run without internet access if keys are provisioned on-prem.

Soojin, Vivek, Hannah — adding you for the technical pieces: please bring any network diagrams you want reviewed and your preferred timing constraints. Also note: for air-gapped model transfers we require a verification window of 48 hours for checksum validation and an agreed tamper-evidence process.
